Balancing new prospecting activities with deal advancement comes naturally to you, and you maintain discipline in sales processes and CRM hygiene.   Your experience includes: At least 7+ years of experience selling B2B Enterprise-level software or related technologies. Proven success in solution and value selling.  A solid track record of landing new logos while growing share of wallet in existing key accounts.  Experience running sales presentations/demos. Track record of swift, targeted contract negotiation to deliver value to your company and customer.  Familiarity with Salesforce.com or similar CRM solutions.  Extra Awesome Experience in Privacy, Security, Third-Party Risk management, Compliance Experience directly selling to the Information Security department CIPP/E or CIPM certified Trained in Command of Message

You will be the technical front line for our largest enterprise customers: diagnosing and resolving production issues, shaping solutions that unlock value from our platform, and translating real-world pain points into product and engineering priorities. This is a high-impact, visible role that reports to the SVP of engineering and partners closely with Product Management, Support, Engineering, and Customer Success. Clear, crisp communication and strong customer empathy are essential. Location and Working Model Location: United States, near a major hub (e.g., SF Bay Area, New York, Atlanta, etc.) Working model: Hybrid (regular in-office collaboration plus flexibility for remote work) Travel: Occasional travel to key customer sites and internal offices as needed Key Responsibilities Act as the primary technical point of contact for a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers using our big-data and high-scale services. Diagnose and troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems, data pipelines, APIs, and integrations, often in live or near-live production contexts. Reproduce, triage, and drive resolution of incidents in partnership with Product Engineering, SRE/CloudOps, and Support. Mentor Support and Customer Success teams on technical topics so they can handle a broader range of issues independently. Ability to use a wide variety of open-source technologies and cloud services (Azure, Google Computer, or Amazon Web Services)

Familiarity with public cloud providers such as (Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS)

Familiarity with different databases (Relational and document) is a strong asset.

Proficiency in Kubernetes, including cluster deployment, scaling, and management is highly desirable.

metadata.value: Strength in Trust OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down - it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like.  OneTrust, the AI‐Ready Governance PlatformTM, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.  The Challenge As a Solution Architect within the Design Partner Program, you will serve as the technical leader responsible for translating strategic customer requirements into scalable, secure, and reusable platform solutions across OneTrust’s AI-Ready Governance Platform. You will operate at the intersection of Product Management, Customer Engineering, Architecture, and Software Development, helping shape the future of Privacy, Consent, Risk, AI Governance, and Compliance solutions. You will work directly with strategic customers, Product Specialists, Engineering leaders, and Product Management teams to understand business objectives, identify architectural patterns, validate technical approaches, and accelerate delivery of customer-driven innovations. Your role is not simply to solve today's customer problem, but to design solutions that scale across the broader OneTrust platform and customer base. Success in this role means accelerating customer adoption, reducing implementation complexity, improving product quality, influencing architecture strategy, and transforming customer requirements into differentiated platform capabilities that create long-term competitive advantage. Your Mission Define Scalable Solution Architectures: Design and evolve scalable architectures spanning Privacy, Consent & Preferences, Risk & Governance, AI Governance, and Compliance solutions. Establish architectural patterns that balance customer flexibility with platform standardization and long-term maintainability. Partner with Strategic Customers: Serve as the trusted technical advisor for Design Partner customers. Lead architecture workshops, solution reviews, integration assessments, and technical discovery sessions to understand complex business requirements and translate them into scalable solution designs. Bridge Product Vision and Technical Execution: Collaborate closely with Product Specialists, Product Management, and Engineering teams to validate designs, refine requirements, and ensure technical feasibility. Help transform customer feedback into product capabilities, reference architectures, and roadmap investments. Drive Platform and Integration Excellence: Define integration patterns, API strategies, data models, identity architectures, event-driven workflows, and governance controls that enable customers to seamlessly connect OneTrust with their broader technology ecosystem. Ensure solutions are secure, scalable, and operationally resilient. Accelerate AI-Powered Solution Innovation: Partner with engineering teams to apply AI-driven approaches that simplify implementation, improve architecture decisions, accelerate troubleshooting, and enhance operational efficiency. Identify opportunities to leverage AI across customer solutions while maintaining governance, security, and compliance requirements. Establish Technical Standards & Best Practices: Drive architecture governance, design reviews, technical standards, and reusable implementation patterns across Customer Engineering and Product Engineering teams. Mentor engineers and architects while helping establish long-term architectural consistency across the platform. You Are A systems thinker who can balance customer requirements, product strategy, and platform scalability. Passionate about solving complex enterprise challenges through elegant technical solutions. Comfortable engaging with architects, engineers, product leaders, executives, and customer stakeholders. Customer-obsessed and motivated by delivering measurable business outcomes through technology. Deeply technical while able to communicate architectural decisions in business terms. A collaborative leader who drives alignment across Product, Engineering, and Customer teams. Energized by creating reusable solutions that benefit both strategic customers and the broader market. Your Experience Includes  12+ years of software engineering, solution architecture, or enterprise architecture experience. Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale SaaS platforms and cloud-native architectures. Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, and integration frameworks. Experience working directly with enterprise customers on solution architecture, requirements analysis, and technical strategy.(Recommended enhancement for DPP alignment.)  Strong understanding of cloud platforms, container technologies, Kubernetes, messaging systems, and modern application architectures. Experience designing secure, scalable, and highly available systems for enterprise environments. Demonstrated ability to influence product direction through architecture leadership and customer insights. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to present to executives, customers, and technical teams. Experience with Privacy, Consent, Risk, Governance, Security, Compliance, Data Management, or AI Governance domains preferred. Experience mentoring engineers and establishing architecture standards across multiple teams.
